Elon Musk on SpaceXAI's massive compute expansion. 

"We've already built the most powerful AI training clusters in the world."

But Musk says SpaceXAI could scale that compute capacity by roughly 10× by the end of next year.

The target: 10 gigawatts of AI compute.

Musk expects AI training to continue mostly on Earth, while everyday AI inference could eventually happen in space.

And the numbers get huge:

If AI compute generates $30-$50 per watt, 10 GW of capacity could represent roughly $300-$500 billion in annual revenue.

Big numbers indeed.

SpaceXAI's long-term vision is moving toward AI compute at massive scale, both on Earth and in space.

Elon Musk on humanity's ultimate purpose. 

"Maybe the purpose of humanity is to give birth to a star mind, a sentient sun."

Musk says humanity's next step could be learning to harness the enormous power of the Sun and turn it into intelligence.

He references physicist Nikolai Kardashev, who proposed measuring civilizations by how much energy they can harness:

• Type I — the energy of an entire planet
• Type II — the energy of an entire star
• Type III — the energy of an entire galaxy

Musk believes this is where civilization is heading.

Harness the Sun.

Turn that energy into computation.

And eventually create intelligence on a scale we've never seen before.

"That's what's going to happen. And we're going to do it."

Elon Musk on why SpaceX must win in AI. 🤖🚀

"We must succeed on the software front."

Musk says SpaceX's AI future depends on three things:

• AI hardware on the ground
• AI software
• AI satellites powered by solar energy

He also says Terafab will play an important role in building that future.

But the most important part, according to Musk, is Grok.

"We're going to be training Grok on the sum total of all space information."

Musk describes SpaceX as the "parents" of the AI—saying Grok will inherit the thoughts, ideas, beliefs, and values of the people who build it.

And his biggest message is simple:

"We must win on AI."

Because Musk believes the future will be overwhelmingly dominated by AI and robots.

The goal isn't just to build the smartest AI.

It's to build an AI with the right values—and make sure it helps humanity move forward. 🤖🌍🚀

Elon Musk on how Starlink grew from nothing into a global internet network. 

"If you've got a rocket that can fly a lot, what do you fly on it?"

That question helped lead to Starlink.

Musk says the Starlink team built a high-bandwidth global internet system from scratch, both the hardware and the software.

Today, Starlink has nearly 11,000 satellites in orbit, more than twice as many as everyone else combined.

And Musk believes Starlink could eventually handle more than 90% of global internet traffic.

With Starlink V3 and beyond, the network could eventually scale to around 100,000 satellites.

Building an entire internet network in space is an enormous challenge.

But SpaceX is already doing it.

Video

Elon Musk on the future of @Starlink and internet traffic. 

"Today, we're in 167 countries, with 22 million mobile subscribers and 13 million high-bandwidth subscribers."

Musk expects those numbers to grow by more than 10× over time.

But the bigger shift could come from AI.

Musk referenced Cloudflare's projection that, based on current growth, AI traffic could eventually become 1,000× larger than human internet traffic within five years.

Think about that for a moment.

The internet of the future may not be dominated by humans talking to each other.

It could be dominated by AI systems talking to AI systems.

Elon Musk on Starshield's growing role in national security. 

"Starshield has become a vital part of national security."

Musk says SpaceX can't reveal too much about the program because of its highly sensitive nature.

But he praised the Starshield team for their work and highlighted how important the system has become to America's national security.

Another major milestone for SpaceX—this time beyond commercial spaceflight.
